purpose: Test whether the participant-disjoint nonlinear decision-function gain reproduces under the formal CandidateModel protocol and transfers to MissingEvent score support and Formal G1 event behavior.

labels.unsupervised: label == -1; excluded from all classifier fitting and supervised metrics

outer_protocol.fit_rule: fit only on outer-train participants; score outer-validation participants once; no outer-validation participant, row, event, or score enters fitting or policy selection

baseline_candidate_model.name: A_current_production_CandidateModel
baseline_candidate_model.objective: binary classification with library log-loss objective
baseline_candidate_model.preprocessing: raw finite imu_stats_v1 feature units; no scaler, feature selection, or resampling
baseline_candidate_model.probability_semantics: model-local probability-like ranking score; not assumed calibrated across estimators

diagnostic_candidate_model.name: N_temporal_probe_preregistered_bounded_nonlinear
diagnostic_candidate_model.objective: binary classification with library log-loss objective
diagnostic_candidate_model.preprocessing: raw finite imu_stats_v1 feature units; no scaler, feature selection, or resampling
diagnostic_candidate_model.probability_semantics: model-local probability-like ranking score; not assumed calibrated across estimators
diagnostic_candidate_model.circuit_breaker: no N2, no parameter change, no additional classifier

score_selection_policy.reason: A and N have different probability calibration; each model derives its own threshold from outer-train scores under the same frozen production policy

inner_candidate_evaluation.fit: fit the candidate model on inner-train participants only
inner_candidate_evaluation.threshold: quantile of inner-train model scores at q
inner_candidate_evaluation.eventization: frozen Formal G1 eventization on inner-valid participants
inner_candidate_evaluation.primary_metric: pooled event recall = covered label-eligible truth events / label-eligible truth events

score_selection_policy.outer_threshold: fit candidate on all outer-train participants, then threshold its outer-train scores at the selected q
score_selection_policy.window_metrics: threshold-free AUROC/AUPRC are computed on outer-validation scores; threshold is used only for policy controls and event replay

eventization_and_formal_g1.scope: eventize each processed record/session separately; never fuse across record boundaries
eventization_and_formal_g1.truth_population: training-eligible events from participant_eligibility_v3 event ledger
eventization_and_formal_g1.coverage_match: a truth event is covered when any predicted interval for its participant has interval IoU > 0.25
eventization_and_formal_g1.formal_gate: all five outer-fold pooled event recalls >= 0.90

controls.covered_event_positives: label == 1 and window overlaps at least one review_report event with taxonomy COVERED
controls.missing_event_positives: label == 1 and window overlaps at least one of the 27 review_report events with taxonomy != COVERED

hard_negatives.membership: frozen production CandidateModel outer-fold OOF score >= 0.5
hard_negatives.source_protocol: same five participant-disjoint outer folds and production CandidateModel parameters above
hard_negatives.diagnostic_circularity: membership is computed before and independently of N scores

easy_negatives.population: label == 0 in the same outer-validation population
easy_negatives.membership: same count as hard negatives, selected from lowest frozen production OOF scores; stable row-key tie break
easy_negatives.use: control only; never used to choose a model or threshold

support_definitions.positive_scores: scores of label==1 windows overlapping the MissingEvent
support_definitions.fraction_above_threshold: positive overlapping windows selected by that model's frozen outer threshold divided by positive overlapping windows
support_definitions.selected_temporal_coverage: union length of selected-window intersections with the event divided by event duration
support_definitions.longest_unsupported_interval: longest contiguous event subinterval not covered by selected-window intersections; event duration if no selected intersection

window_level_metrics.per_fold: computed independently for each outer fold
window_level_metrics.participant_level: computed independently for each held-out participant when both classes are present; otherwise null with reason
window_level_metrics.comparison: N minus A within the same outer fold, participant, and control population

reproduction_gate.fold_direction: at least 4 of 5 finite AUROC fold deltas > 0
reproduction_gate.participant_direction: at least 60 percent of comparable participants have delta > 0 and improved_count > degraded_count
reproduction_gate.hard_negative_guard: hard-negative AUROC delta >= -0.03; score P90 increase alone is not evidence of improvement

window_level_metrics.failure_action: if N does not pass the window-level reproduction gate, write DECISION_FUNCTION_EFFECT=NOT_REPRODUCED and stop before event-level interpretation

event_level_replay.precondition: window-level nonlinear decision-function improvement passes the reproduction gate
event_level_replay.score_source: only outer-validation N scores from the preregistered model and outer-train-derived policy
event_level_replay.recovered_events: originally uncovered under A and covered under N at the same outer-fold policy
event_level_replay.newly_lost_events: covered under A and uncovered under N at the same outer-fold policy

formal_interpretation.B: meaningful stable event-level improvement but still FAIL

escalation.candidate_model_design_review: JUSTIFIED only if window-level improvement reproduces; multiple folds and participants benefit; MissingEvent usable score support improves; hard negatives do not materially degenerate; event-level replay improves Formal G1 behavior; and no single fold/participant drives the gain

before_evaluation: source artifact hashes match recorded values
A feature width is 111 and all features are finite
N exactly matches the temporal probe preregistered N definition
outer and inner folds are participant-disjoint
after_evaluation: report records the frozen spec hash
all score arrays are finite and aligned

stop_rule: evaluate exactly A and N with imu_stats_v1 under this protocol; do not add candidates, features, parameters, thresholds, or aggregation variants after evaluation
